name: Yasho Industries Limited
summary: Yasho Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of specialty and fine chemicals in India, the United States, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. The company offers aroma chemicals, including clove oil and derivatives; food antioxidants; and rubber chemicals comprising accelerators/antioxidants/co-agents for processing EPDM, SBR, NBR, ECO, Acrylic, NR, and others. It also provides pre-dispersed rubber chemicals, such as sulfur and metal oxides, dithiocarbamate, thiuram and sulfur donors, guinidines/sulphenamides/thioureas, thiazoles and thioures, crosslinking agents, peroxide co-agents and dithiophosphates, and antioxidants; additives for industrial/automotive lube and greases, in…
